name: Kit
label: Kit API V4 — forms, sequences, tags, subscribers (ConvertKit rebrand)
description: Official Kit API V4 at https://api.kit.com/v4 (ConvertKit rebrand). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth header X-Kit-Api-Key. V3 api_secret is not used. Subscribers are PII; caller owns consent. Customer owns the Kit account. api_key is never logged or returned. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put api_key here. subscriber.addToForm requires form_id + email_address. Example: {"operation":"form.list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT V4 verbs including trigger.listen. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: form_id
schema.description: Form id path for addToForm / listByForm.

schema.label: sequence_id
schema.description: Sequence id path for addToSequence / listBySequence.

schema.label: tag_id
schema.description: Tag id path for tag subscriber ops.

schema.label: subscriber_id
schema.description: Subscriber id for addToSequence / tag.add / tag.remove.

schema.label: email_address
schema.description: Subscriber email. Official email_address for addToForm / addToSequence / tag.add / tag.remove. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: state
schema.description: Subscriber state for addToForm. Typical: active | cancelled | bounced | complained.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Page size for list operations. Example: 50.

schema.label: label
schema.description: Custom field label for customField.create / customField.update.

schema.label: custom_field_id
schema.description: Custom field id path for update/delete.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Do not log emails, phones, or secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: Kit V4 verbs. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Kit V4 API key (StudioQuack secret). Sent as X-Kit-Api-Key. Never log or place on INPUT. Dashboard: https://app.kit.com/

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
